learning_outcomes.text: Recognize which questions in engineering sciences can be answered with the help of mathematics, and can ask such questions themselves.
Understand logical argumentation, recognize condition, consequence and rule, and they can build an argumentation chain in the context of engineering applications.
Recognize known types of tasks in known and in new contexts, can solve these tasks with known procedures.
Are able to understand the mathematical language used in engineering literature and describe their own argumentation and solution approaches orally and in writing.
Can confidently deal with the presented mathematical methods.

syllabus_topics: Complex Numbers: Fundamentals, calculation rules, applications
Sequences and Series: Fundamentals, convergence, applications
Differential Calculus in R: Fundamentals, differentiation rules, applications
Integral Calculus in R: Fundamentals, integration methods, applications
Ordinary Differential Equations: Fundamentals, solution methods, applications
assessment_rules: The bonus point system according to the examination regulations of TH Ingolstadt can optionally be used by the lecturers of this module. The decision will be announced at the beginning of the course.
